text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew… Our visit to the shrine went perfectly! Thank you for accompanying me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now my poor condition should recover before—huh?
Sh-she's not the only one! I can draw a great fortune slip in one pull too!
I'll show her! I won't lose, even when it comes to luck!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Good day. ♪ Are you trying to draw a great fortune slip?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: K-Kawakami?! How much did you hear just now?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-it's not what you think! I'm not trying to compete with her or anything!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Don't be like that. ♪ You should aim for the top in everything you do! Which means shooting for great fortune too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll support you with my One Hundred Princess Prayers!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, I remember seeing that on Princess Fighter when I was little. The princess visited the shrine a hundred times to support her friend…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But… are you actually going to do that all for me?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ I've been training every day, so all that running should be a breeze!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaghhh! One! Two! Threeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess begins sprinting back and forth between the torii gate and main shrine. …It looks like a shuttle run in gym class.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kawakami… She's really going all out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, seeing her strength is always so encouraging… I need to work hard too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze… Ninety-nine! One hundred! All right!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I pray that Scarlet draws a great fortune sliiiip!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Scarlet! What did you get?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …It says "Great Fortune"! I got it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: OH YEAAAH! I knew it! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you so much! This is thanks to the courage you've given me, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, no, you're the one who drew the fortune! I did nothing more than give a little push. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Scarlet's smile brings delight to Kawakami Princess. It seems she's completely recovered from her poor condition!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-you won't believe this, but… the fortune slip box was completely empty!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: How can that be?! That means I wasn't able to help you at all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's fine! Seeing you run has inspired me, Kawakami! I'll come back another time and draw a great fortune slip by my own effort!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Scarlet…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urghhh… She's such a wonderful Umamusume. I really wanted to give her a boost of confidence…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess becomes downhearted, and her condition doesn't appear to have improved…
